stem: Two rooms deliver nearly the same DLI, but Room A uses a shorter photoperiod at higher PPFD while Room B uses a longer photoperiod at lower PPFD. Which conclusion is strongest?
choices: The crops must respond identically because DLI is equal
The schedules can produce different responses because instantaneous intensity and photoperiod can matter beyond total daily photons
Only Room A has a meaningful light dose
DLI cannot be compared unless fixture wattage is identical
rationale: DLI integrates photon quantity over time but does not erase biological effects associated with instantaneous intensity, photoperiod, spectrum, or interacting environmental conditions.
